motivation: After new modeling, 46-49 percent of residual SSE still lies in candidate fully visible areas. Test numerical deflection at earlier intersections with the raised receiver surface.
intervention: Identical source directions, terrain, reflection background, 16 equal-area samples per triangle. Change only the normal-directed origin offset after receiver hits. Validate flat plane and compare quadrature 16 vs36.
positivity_gate: Only consider a learned follow-up if the pre-calibrated correction in separate terrain holdout reduces clear-zone RMSE at least .05 dB in both bands and total RMSE at least .03 dB each.
official_training_use: Diagnostic only, no official VAL selection or synthetic targets.
